Al principio está “joven”:\n- no dispara DD a tiempo\n- cuando finalmente dispara, el baseline ya va muriendo\n- la ventaja se ve **tarde**\n\n## Regla nueva (alineada a Centinela)\n\n| Fase | Ciclos | Quién manda DD |\n|------|--------|----------------|\n| **Pre-flight** | `0 .. warm_up-1` | **Determinista** (Centinela): DD ON mientras Ojos/Juicio aprenden |\n| **Causal** | `warm_up ..` | **Juicio** esporádico (do Z, régimen, HIS falling, cooldown) |\n\nMORPH sigue **siempre** activo bajo Ojos. Solo cambia **cuándo** Manos aplica DD.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"9f9aa508-e4f9-49e7-b000-25c5e2b6ea3c","cell_type":"code","source":"import json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\nOUT = Path(\"outputs_preflight\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\nRNG = np.random.default_rng(42)\n\nclass Regime(str, Enum):\n    ESTABLE = \"ESTABLE\"\n    INESTABLE = \"INESTABLE\"\n    CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\nclass Intervention(str, Enum):\n    HOLD = \"HOLD\"\n    REMAP_ONLY = \"REMAP_ONLY\"\n    DD_PREFLIGHT = \"DD_PREFLIGHT\"      # determinista al inicio\n    DD_CONDITIONAL = \"DD_CONDITIONAL\"  # causal esporadico\n\ndef HIS(h_id, h_re, eps=1e-8):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < eps else max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d)\n\n@dataclass\nclass HamiltonianSpec:\n    n_logical: int\n    h_ideal: float\n\n@dataclass\nclass QPUState:\n    n_physical: int\n    cycle: int\n    t1: Dict[int, float]\n    t2: Dict[int, float]\n    readout: Dict[int, float]\n    detuning: Dict[int, float]\n    gate2q: Dict[int, float]\n    coupling_map: List[Tuple[int, int]]\n    layout: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)\n    dd_on: bool = False\n    dd_seq: str = \"NONE\"\n    phase_vz: float = 0.0\n\ndef evolve_qpu(n_phys, cycle, drift_qubits):\n    t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 5.0 * cycle) if q in drift_qubits else 150.0 + float(RNG.normal(0, 3))\n        t1[q] = max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + float(RNG.normal(0, 2)))\n        readout[q] = 0.012 + (0.04 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * min(1.0, cycle / 25.0)\n        detuning[q] = (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -21.0) + float(RNG.normal(0, 0.3))\n        gate2q[q] = 0.006 + (0.012 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * min(1.0, cycle / 20.0)\n    return QPUState(n_phys, cycle, t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q,\n                    [(i, i + 1) for i in range(n_phys - 1)])\n\ndef public_signals(qpu):\n    return {\n        \"t1\": dict(qpu.t1), \"t2\": dict(qpu.t2), \"readout\": dict(qpu.readout),\n        \"detuning\": dict(qpu.detuning), \"gate2q\": dict(qpu.gate2q),\n        \"coupling_map\": list(qpu.coupling_map), \"n_physical\": qpu.n_physical,\n    }\n\ndef qubit_friction_from_signals(sig, q):\n    f = max(0.0, 1.0 - sig[\"t2\"][q] / 150.0) * 0.35\n    f += max(0.0, 1.0 - sig[\"t1\"][q] / 100.0) * 0.15\n    f += min(1.0, sig[\"readout\"][q] / 0.05) * 0.25\n    f += min(1.0, abs(sig[\"detuning\"][q]) / 30.0) * 0.10\n    f += min(1.0, sig[\"gate2q\"][q] / 0.02) * 0.15\n    return float(np.clip(f, 0, 1))\n\ndef layout_friction(sig, layout):\n    return float(np.mean([qubit_friction_from_signals(sig, q) for q in layout]))\n\nprint(\"base OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T10:09:06.150167Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T10:09:06.150542Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T10:09:06.173439Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T10:09:06.150512Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T10:09:06.172228Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"base OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":14},{"id":"6714fe48-61fb-43b6-aafb-712e770b0a9f","cell_type":"code","source":"class Ojos:\n    def __init__(self, hist_n=8):\n        self.buf, self.capacity, self.regime = [], hist_n, Regime.ESTABLE\n\n    def observe(self, sig):\n        n = sig[\"n_physical\"]\n        health = {q: 1.0 - qubit_friction_from_signals(sig, q) for q in range(n)}\n        friction = float(np.mean([1.0 - health[q] for q in range(n)]))\n        self.buf.append(friction)\n        if len(self.buf) > self.capacity:\n            self.buf.pop(0)\n        smoothed = float(np.mean(self.buf))\n        # tendencia temprana (para handoff)\n        trend = 0.3\n        if len(self.buf) >= 3:\n            trend = self.buf[-1] - self.buf[0]\n        if self.regime == Regime.ESTABLE:\n            if smoothed >= 0.40: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n            if smoothed >= 0.55: self.regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n        elif self.regime == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            if smoothed >= 0.55: self.regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n            elif smoothed < 0.28: self.regime = Regime.ESTABLE\n        else:\n            if smoothed < 0.42: self.regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n        candidates = sorted(health, key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        return {\"friction\": friction, \"smoothed\": smoothed, \"regime\": self.regime,\n                \"health\": health, \"candidates\": candidates, \"trend\": trend,\n                \"n_obs\": len(self.buf)}\n\n\nclass Reflejos:\n    def __init__(self, n_logical):\n        self.n_logical = n_logical\n\n    def select(self, sig, eyes, obs_fb=None):\n        health = dict(eyes[\"health\"])\n        contrast = 1.0\n        if obs_fb is not None:\n            his = float(obs_fb.get(\"HIS\", 1.0))\n            if his < 0.75:\n                contrast = 1.0 + 0.8 * (0.75 - his)\n            mean_h = float(np.mean(list(health.values())))\n            health = {q: float(np.clip(mean_h + contrast * (h - mean_h), 0.0, 1.0))\n                      for q, h in health.items()}\n        ranked = sorted(health.keys(), key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        edges = {(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in sig[\"coupling_map\"]}\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden:\n                avoided += 1\n                continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a, b in edges:\n                if a == q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b == q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical:\n                break\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n_logical:\n                break\n            if q not in selected:\n                selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[: self.n_logical]\n        score = float(np.mean([health[q] for q in selected]))\n        return {\"selected\": selected, \"score\": score, \"edges_avoided\": avoided, \"contrast\": contrast}\n\n\nclass Juicio:\n    \"\"\"\n    warm_up: ciclos con DD_PREFLIGHT determinista.\n    Luego causal esporadico. Opcional: early_trend acelera salida del warm-up\n    o permite primer DD causal antes si la friccion ya sube claro.\n    \"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, warm_up=6, cooldown=4, do_z_min=0.32):\n        self.warm_up = warm_up\n        self.cooldown = cooldown\n        self.do_z_min = do_z_min\n        self.prev_his = 1.0\n        self.last_dd = -10**9\n\n    def decide(self, H, cycle, eyes, morph, obs_fb):\n        do_a = max(0.0, 0.90 - morph[\"score\"]) * 0.6\n        do_z = eyes[\"friction\"] * 0.9\n        if eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            do_z += 0.18\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            do_z += 0.09\n        his_falling = False\n        if obs_fb is not None:\n            his_now = float(obs_fb.get(\"HIS\", self.prev_his))\n            if his_now < self.prev_his - 0.04:\n                his_falling = True\n                do_z += 0.10\n            self.prev_his = his_now\n\n        # --- PRE-FLIGHT: Juicio aun \"joven\" ---\n        if cycle < self.warm_up:\n            self.last_dd = cycle\n            return {\n                \"intervention\": Intervention.DD_PREFLIGHT,\n                \"targets\": list(morph[\"selected\"]),\n                \"expected_gain\": float(do_z),\n                \"reason\": \"centinela_preflight\",\n                \"do_a\": do_a, \"do_z\": do_z,\n                \"regime\": eyes[\"regime\"], \"his_falling\": his_falling,\n                \"phase\": \"preflight\",\n            }\n\n        # --- CAUSAL ---\n        cooled = (cycle - self.last_dd) >= self.cooldown\n        want_dd = cooled and (\n            (do_z >= self.do_z_min and eyes[\"regime\"] in (Regime.INESTABLE, Regime.CONFLICTO))\n            or (his_falling and do_z >= self.do_z_min * 0.85)\n            or (eyes[\"trend\"] > 0.16 and do_z >= self.do_z_min * 0.5)  # tendencia temprana\n        )\n        if want_dd:\n            self.last_dd = cycle\n            inter, reason = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"causal_dd\"\n            gain = float(do_z)\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.ESTABLE and morph[\"score\"] >= 0.50:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.HOLD, \"hold\", 0.0\n        else:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.REMAP_ONLY, \"morph_active\", float(do_a)\n        return {\n            \"intervention\": inter, \"targets\": list(morph[\"selected\"]),\n            \"expected_gain\": gain, \"reason\": reason,\n            \"do_a\": do_a, \"do_z\": do_z,\n            \"regime\": eyes[\"regime\"], \"his_falling\": his_falling,\n            \"phase\": \"causal\",\n        }\n\n\nclass Manos:\n    def act(self, H, qpu, plan):\n        dd = plan[\"intervention\"] in (Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, Intervention.DD_PREFLIGHT)\n        seq = \"CPMG\" if dd else \"NONE\"\n        phase = 0.0\n        if dd and plan[\"targets\"]:\n            phase = float(np.mean([qpu.detuning.get(q, 0.0) for q in plan[\"targets\"]])) * 1e-3\n        qpu.layout = list(plan[\"targets\"])\n        qpu.dd_on, qpu.dd_seq, qpu.phase_vz = dd, seq, phase\n        return {\"dd_applied\": dd, \"sequence\": seq, \"phase_vz\": phase,\n                \"layout\": list(qpu.layout), \"mode\": plan[\"intervention\"].value}\n\ndef run_workload(H, sig, layout, dd, phase=0.0):\n    fr = layout_friction(sig, layout)\n    mit = 0.62 if dd else 1.0\n    if phase > 0:\n        mit *= max(0.85, 1.0 - min(0.1, phase))\n    h_real = H.h_ideal * (1.0 - min(0.95, fr * mit))\n    return {\"layout\": list(layout), \"dd\": dd, \"friction\": fr, \"mitigation\": mit,\n            \"H_ideal\": H.h_ideal, \"H_real\": h_real, \"HIS\": HIS(H.h_ideal, h_real)}\n\nprint(\"modulos que preguntas\n1. ¿Hamiltoniano → causalidad para “mejorar”?\nNo como sesgo del hardware.\n\nSí: H define el observable → HIS es la métrica de éxito.\nNo: multiplicar do(Z) por |H| no entiende mejor Eso no es causalidad del estado físico; es un atajo numérico.\n\nLa causalidad del ruido debe salir de Ojos + señales públicas + HIS que cae, no de la forma del Hamiltoniano.\n2. ¿Juicio solo a través de DD (“el bebé”)?\nNo debería. Validación vs rediseño\nTienes razón: esto ya es validación de reglas, no otro rediseño del motor.\nReglas que quedan cerradas:\n\nPre-flight DD determinista (warm_up) mientras Juicio es joven.\nLuego DD causal esporádico.\nMORPH continuo bajo Ojos.\nJuicio puede actuar directo sobre Reflejos, no solo sobre Manos.\nH entra en HIS, no en la física de do(Z).\n\nSi el siguiente paso es solo evidencia, se congela este protocolo y se documentan Δ, early Δ, DD preflight vs causal — sin tocar más la topología.","metadata":{}}]}
